levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن زرارة

notes: «[17/172] رجال الكشي» is a source label: left out.
«عبد الله بن زرارة» stands at two positions of the chain (levels 4 and 8): kept as two links, not merged.
«و ابنيه» is relation to Muhammad b. Abdallah; each son is written by name alone (rule 7).
The Imam is named only in the words («قال لي أبو عبد الله»): last link, imam_in_text.
